decisions.statement: A row never names a page that is not there.
Every path answered here is opened at the moment of answering.
A page is made to declare the id that page was found under.
A subagent is keyed off its page rather than off the page's file name.
A subagent page short of its seat name or its agent id is left out.
The kind a subagent was dispatched as is read off that subagent's page.
A subagent page stating no kind answers null for that kind.
Whether a subagent was stopped from the panel is read from beside its page.

definition: the akasha page a running agent has, answered only where the file is there
